sources.title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
read_locators: §1: weights-only storage versus real hardware efficiency
§2.1, Eq. (1): affine quantization r = S(q-Z), finite bit representation and extra scale/zero-point
§3, Eq. (12): rounding/clamping; simulated quantized forward during training
§3.1: weight versus input-dependent activation range selection

short_excerpts.quote: Approaches that quantize only the weights ... are primarily concerned with on-device storage and less with computational efficiency.
We propose an approach that simulates quantization effects in the forward pass of training.

sources.inspection_note: 直接讀原論文相關段落，非讀候選摘要；其 ARM/CNN 結果只支持限定的實作，不能用作本 repo 或所有硬體的加速實測。

sources.title: Neural Discrete Representation Learning
read_locators: §3.1, Eqs. (1)-(2), p.3: K finite entries, nearest neighbor, embedding lookup into decoder
§3.2, Eq. (3), pp.3-4: no real gradient for hard quantization, straight-through approximation, separate codebook and commitment losses
§4.3, p.6: encode audio into discrete latents and reconstruct audio

short_excerpts.quote: The discrete latent variables z are then calculated by a nearest neighbour look-up using the shared embedding space e
there is no real gradient defined for equation 2, however we approximate the gradient similar to the straight-through estimator
The VQ objective uses the l2 error to move the embedding vectors ei towards the encoder outputs ze(x)

sources.inspection_note: 硬選碼對 encoder 是分區常數／跨邊界跳變，近似反向不是真導數。選中碼本向量可另由自己的 objective 學，並非所有參數都無梯度；未把一次 toy update 當成音質。

sources.title: High Fidelity Neural Audio Compression
read_locators: §3 Model, p.3: audio encoder, quantized latent representation, decoder reconstruction
§3.2 Residual Vector Quantization, p.4: closest codebook vector; next codebook quantizes residual; EMA and STE training

short_excerpts.quote: RVQ refines this process by computing the residual after quantization, and further quantizing it using a second codebook, and so forth.

sources.inspection_note: 這是音訊 latent 的量化；碼本數目與位元率有關，並非把 codec 模型自己的權重存成低 bit。逐次量化剩餘量不保證任意額外碼本都改善主觀音質。

short_excerpts.quote: It requires calibration with a representative dataset to determine optimal quantization parameters for activations.

We can do QAT for static, dynamic or weight only quantization. During training, all calculations are done in floating point, with fake_quant modules modeling the effects of quantization by clamping and rounding
x86 CPUs with AVX2 support or higher (without AVX2 some operations have inefficient implementations)
